nodes.label: ADR-0001 Content as Local Typed Data
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001 content as local typed data
nodes.rationale: Use typed local data module (lib/projects.ts) instead of CMS or MDX; a CMS adds hosting/auth/fetch layers for no benefit with three projects, MDX tooling not justified; pages only consume the Project shape so a CMS could slot in behind the same types.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 Motion for Animations
nodes.rationale: Build animations on the motion package (framer-motion successor, React 19 compatible) instead of hand-rolled CSS+IntersectionObserver for whileInView ergonomics, consistent easing via MotionConfig, built-in prefers-reduced-motion; micro-interactions stay in plain CSS so the motion runtime isn't paying for trivial hovers.
